intended_object: The docstring calls it an "Auxiliary definition for `AlgebraicGeometry.PresheafedSpace.colimitCoconeIsColimit`". It gives, for each open set U of the cocone point, the component at U of the presheaf map in the morphism from the colimit presheafed space to an arbitrary cocone.
explanation: This is a step inside the proof that the explicit colimit cocone of presheafed spaces is a colimit. For each open U, it builds the component map from s.pt.presheaf(U) into the pushforward of the limit presheaf. It does so with `limit.lift`, using the maps (s.ι j).c.app U and some eqToHom transports. It is part of the construction of the universal morphism, not a mathematical notion in its own right, and the docstring itself labels it auxiliary. So it is an implementation detail with no counterpart of its own in the literature.
